name: American Auditory Society
usageNote: Logo image referenced from the official AAS website header. No separate brand guideline page found. Verify permission before public display if the site is commercial or endorsement could be implied.
sourceEvidence: Official website exposes /assets/site/aas-logo.png in the page header.

name: Acoustical Society of America
usageNote: Use the official brand pack where possible. ASA states that its master brand is available in EPS, PNG and JPG and should not be manipulated. Use the public PNG only as a fallback.
sourceEvidence: ASA brand toolkit page lists Master Brand Files and a downloadable ZIP of ASA Master Brand Logos.

name: European Acoustics Association
usageNote: Logo image from the official EAA site. No dedicated brand usage guide found during this pass.

name: Society for Music Production Research
usageNote: The official site currently appears to use text-based SMPR branding rather than a downloadable logo asset. Keep the local typographic fallback unless the organisation provides a logo file.
sourceEvidence: Official site shows text branding: SMPR / Society for Music Production Research.

name: Society for Music Theory
usageNote: Use the official logo guidelines PDF. The available public image is a white/gray header variant; consider asking SMT for the preferred production asset for dark/light cards.
sourceEvidence: SMT site references the logo in the footer and provides an official logo guidelines PDF.

name: Society for Music Analysis
usageNote: Header logo from the official SMA site. It includes an NCVO member ribbon; crop/use only if acceptable and without implying endorsement.

name: Society for Music Perception and Cognition
usageNote: Official site image URL discovered, but web-tool fetch timed out once. The local download script should retry on the user's machine.
sourceEvidence: Official SMPC site references a Squarespace-hosted logo/image asset.

name: Cognitive Science Society
usageNote: Logo from the official Cognitive Science Society website. No separate brand kit found during this pass.

name: Institute of Electrical and Electronics Engineers
usageNote: Do not use a third-party logo file as official. Download from IEEE Brand Experience after logging in/accepting access conditions, then place it manually in public/images/organizations/official/.
sourceEvidence: IEEE policy/search evidence points to IEEE Brand Experience / Master Brand and Logos; direct access was blocked for the browsing tool.

name: Association for Computing Machinery
usageNote: ACM identity standards page lists downloadable SVG/PNG files, but direct file fetch returned 403 in the web tool. Download manually from the page or use browser right-click as instructed by ACM.
sourceEvidence: ACM Open Logo Matrix lists Color SVG and Color PNG downloads.

name: Audio Engineering Society
usageNote: AES states that logos should only appear in navy #063B59, white or black and should never be altered. Use the downloaded pack and keep the mark unchanged.
sourceEvidence: AES official Logos page exposes image previews and a Download Logos ZIP.

name: Polish Acoustical Society
usageNote: Official site found. The current web extraction did not expose a usable separate logo image. Keep the custom fallback or manually extract an approved logo if available from PTA.
sourceEvidence: Official PTA website and organisation identity verified; no public brand kit found.

name: Federation of Scientific and Technical Associations – Supreme Technical Organization
usageNote: Logo from the official eNOT/FSNT-NOT site. Use without recolouring. The white icon variant is also available.
sourceEvidence: Official eNOT page exposes logo-big.png and logo-white.png.

name: Polish Association of Sound Engineers
usageNote: The historical PSRD domain is referenced in Polish vocational resources, but no stable official logo asset was found. Keep placeholder or request a file directly from the organisation/Adam Rosiński.
sourceEvidence: ARD and NGO/profile pages confirm the organisation context; no official logo pack identified.
